nativeRepresentationFindings.MongoDB: UTC metadata projection values are exact ticks, not BSON dates; calendar conversion must preserve integer day boundaries without floating epoch rounding.
nativeRepresentationFindings.SQLite: Admitted UTC metadata values are calendar strings; component extraction must not round fractional seconds through a temporal parser.
nativeRepresentationFindings.Neo4j: Admitted UTC metadata values normalize to fixed-width calendar strings; native temporal conversion must remain guard-bound.
